description.p: pdf-rust is a small, dependency-free PDF viewer. It renders pages with PDFium on a background worker, keeps already-rendered pages in a byte bounded cache and remembers what you were reading.

ul.li: Single-page and continuous scrolling views with zoom presets
Rotate pages, page thumbnails, document outline and full-text search
Text selection and copy, find-as-you-type highlighting
Full-screen presentation mode with page transitions
Printing through the platform print dialog, encrypted PDF support
